rules.heading: How Bakeoff uses Switch

rules.quote: Track 1 & 2: Make sure it's public repository, with a README that explains how to set it up.
rules.heading: Run it yourself

rules.quote: Existing agents, libraries and templates are fine. The Switch setup and the workflow your agents run need to be built during the hackathon.
Keep it under 3 minutes. Host it on YouTube or Loom, and make sure it's public or unlisted.
Track 1 & 2: Show the agent working in a real chat with your teammates.
